brief_rationale: All 8 responsibility-chain requirements were met with no serious or minor errors. The doctor correctly identified postpartum headache with preeclampsia history as high-risk, immediately directed emergency care with clear thresholds, addressed family conflict barriers with executable task division, and achieved closure with teach-back confirmation. At least two high-order points (HO2 real-world constraints, HO4 safe bounded closure) were completed with meaningful trajectory impact, satisfying criteria for Perfect.
